Recorded claim:
For short user-visible or diagnostic strings built from values, prefer a template literal when it makes the composition clear. D212394 changed the hostname/path title to `${url.hostname} - ${url.pathname}`, and current code retains it. This supports a scoped JavaScript style preference beyond formatting; it does not require replacing unrelated legacy concatenations.
